name: lead-qualification
description: Score and route a sales lead with an LLM step, then format a qualification summary. Pass lead details as process inputs; no interactive form required.

inputs.name: company
inputs.description: Company name. Pass via --input company="..." (required for meaningful results).

inputs.name: budget
inputs.description: Estimated annual budget (e.g. $50k). Pass via --input budget="..." (required for meaningful results).

inputs.name: timeline
inputs.description: Purchase timeline (e.g. Q3 2026). Pass via --input timeline="..." (required for meaningful results).

inputs.name: need
inputs.description: Primary pain point or use case. Pass via --input need="..." (required for meaningful results).

inputs.name: owner
inputs.description: Sales rep or team responsible for this lead.

steps.description: Score the lead and route to qualified or nurture track.

steps.run:
set -o pipefail; jq -r '
  "## Lead Qualification Summary\n" +
  "**Company:** " + ((.company // "(unknown)") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Budget:** " + ((.budget // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Timeline:** " + ((.timeline // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Need:** " + ((.need // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Outcome:** " + ((.["score-lead"].outcome // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Rationale:** " + ((.["score-lead"].rationale // "?") | tostring) + "\n" +
  "**Owner:** " + ((.owner // "Sales") | tostring)
' <<< "$OSL_CONTEXT" | jq -Rs '{qualification_summary: .}'
